name: APIGen-MT-5k
summary: Salesforce dataset of 5,000 verified multi-turn agent trajectories (retail and airline, tau-bench style) for training and evaluating tool-calling agents.
description:
Generated by the APIGen-MT pipeline (simulated agent-human interplay) and verified through format checks, function execution and domain policy checks, and semantic verification; a 200-sample human evaluation reported a 99% success rate. ShareGPT-like JSON, a subset of the data used to train Salesforce's xLAM-2 models. Paper: [arXiv:2504.03601](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.03601).

**Access:** gated on Hugging Face (accept the terms and log in); **license CC BY-NC 4.0** (non-commercial).

agent_access.notes: Gated dataset: requires a Hugging Face account and accepting the usage terms before download.
